scope: Obligation layer for finite stochastic semantics, infinite-horizon quantifier boundaries, continuum lifting, and prevalence claims. It separates relation reachability from stochastic support, finite-horizon evidence from infinite-path liveness, finite samples from model probabilities, finite counterexamples from prevalence, and finite-grid conformance from continuum conclusions.

quantifiers.exists: at least one admissible or support witness exists
quantifiers.positive_probability: the declared probability measure assigns event mass greater than zero
quantifiers.almost_sure: the declared probability measure assigns event mass exactly one
quantifiers.finite_horizon: the event is evaluated only through an explicitly finite horizon
quantifiers.infinite_horizon: the event is defined on an infinite path space with an explicitly declared limiting or measure-theoretic semantics

execution_limits.policy: The executable battery uses exact Fraction arithmetic on bounded finite probability models and exact rational polynomial controls. It verifies declared finite obligations and counterexamples only; it does not establish arbitrary stochastic-process, measure-theoretic, continuum, ergodic, prevalence, or infinite-path theorems.

explicit_deferrals: ergodicity, mixing, stationarity, and invariant-measure theorems
continuum existence, compactness, regularity, and convergence proofs
measure concentration and asymptotic prevalence theorems
empirical frequency calibration and statistical inference to planned PR #18
